title: Zoom Reports Q3 Revenue of $1,290.6 Million, Starts Dividend
summary: Zoom Communications reported third-quarter fiscal 2027 revenue of $1,290.6 million, up 4.9% year over year, and started a $0.25 quarterly dividend.
body_markdown:
GAAP operating margin was 24.6% and non-GAAP operating margin was 41.6%. Free cash flow was $558.1 million, compared with $614.3 million a year earlier. Zoom repurchased approximately 3.9 million shares in the quarter, bringing the total under its current plan to 48.1 million, and its board declared the first dividend of its new quarterly program, $0.25 per share.


For the fourth quarter of fiscal year 2027, Zoom expects total revenue between $1.293 billion and $1.298 billion and non-GAAP diluted EPS between $1.55 and $1.57. The company updated its full-year guidance to total revenue between $5.100 billion and $5.105 billion, non-GAAP diluted EPS between $6.24 and $6.25, and free cash flow between $1.780 billion and $1.820 billion.


## Why It Matters for ZM


"Zoom delivered another strong quarter, with Enterprise revenue growth accelerating to its strongest pace in 13 quarters," founder and CEO Eric S. Yuan said, adding that Zoom Customer Experience posted its seventh consecutive quarter of high double-digit year-over-year ARR growth. According to the release, the trailing 12-month net dollar expansion rate for Enterprise customers rose to 100% from 98% a year earlier, and 4,732 customers contributed more than $100,000 in trailing 12 months revenue, up 8.5%. Online average monthly churn was 2.8%, compared with 2.7% a year earlier.
